dense_content: Successfully completed Sprint 1 (Fase 6: FONDASI & KEAMANAN) for the SIP-DADES-BAKEUDA application. Created DB migrations to support status_pbb_lunas attribute and rate_limit table in Appwrite. Implemented fail-closed OCR API kill-switch and dynamic manual-input UI. Integrated real-time billing cost reporting (Gemini, RunPod GPU). Standardized database attributes across pages, hooks, and API routes (status_verifikasi, nominal_pencairan_net, desa_id). Implemented distributed rate limiter and resilient MCP client.
facts: Appwrite schema migration completed successfully for 224 village records.
Project built successfully with 0 errors via npm run build.
Regression testing completed with 100% success rate on 1,000 transactions.
